reviews.name: patch.get_rev
reviews.proof: A02FB08C invokes the DS scalar reader for DSID 0x1088F then truncates to uint8; output is %4u;. It does not apply a patch.
reviews.side_effects_assessment: Only reads local firmware/RAM data and formats UART output; no persistent update or external transmission.

reviews.name: patch.get_v_string
reviews.proof: Handler ends at A02FBB0C and obtains the literal TJP1FN1809AR pointer through A046E262, computes string length, and writes UDW.
reviews.side_effects_assessment: Only reads local firmware/RAM data and formats UART output; no persistent update or external transmission.

reviews.name: patch.get
reviews.proof: Fixed loop over 14 patch slots. A02FB04E reads DSID 0x105E2 record index 0..13, length 1900, into the firmware-owned buffer at 20BDE71C; the handler prints a bounded 0x104-byte textual prefix per slot. Physical storage metadata confirms count 14, size 1900. This is the dedicated firmware buffer, not the unproven scratch buffer of nvm2.get_rec_array_for_contents.
reviews.side_effects_assessment: Refreshes the existing firmware patch-read buffer in RAM and emits textual prefixes; no patch apply or DS write.
reviews.output_completeness: Fourteen textual prefixes, not the raw 1900-byte contents of all records.

reviews.name: timer.conv_int
reviews.proof: Parser %d writes an initialized local epoch value; A0430832 converts it via the local time conversion routine A04E3FF0. Three nonnegative signed-32-bit values cover epoch zero, next day, and maximum positive epoch. No date-set helper is called.
reviews.side_effects_assessment: Only reads local firmware/RAM data and formats UART output; no persistent update or external transmission.

reviews.name: timer.delay_ms
reviews.proof: Both aliases point to A042F598; exactly one %d is supplied. Positive value 1 is multiplied by 1000 and passed to A042EE2C; no uninitialized no-argument path or large wait.
reviews.side_effects_assessment: Briefly blocks the command thread for the requested delay; normal timer/scheduler bookkeeping only.

reviews.name: udw.delay

reviews.name: nca.get_preferred_address
reviews.proof: A02D5D00 initializes its output, locks NCA state, traverses the current adapter count and copies a cached preferred IPv4/IPv6 address. A02E1888 formats the copied address or No address found; no scan, connect, DNS, or transmit path.
reviews.side_effects_assessment: Only reads local firmware/RAM data and formats UART output; no persistent update or external transmission.

reviews.name: nca.get_preferred_fqdn
reviews.proof: A02D5DE4 builds a name from locally stored hostname/domain. Fallback A00962DA reads a local adapter pointer and A00950C2 locks/copies cached domain-list pointers; no DNS resolver/transmit call. Output capacity is 256 bytes and the helper initializes output length.
reviews.side_effects_assessment: Only reads local firmware/RAM data and formats UART output; no persistent update or external transmission.

reviews.name: icc.get_url
reviews.proof: A0178D18 reads firmware string selector 4 via A046E15C, selects/refreshes a cached server URL and copies the host portion into a caller buffer. The reviewed path performs string operations only; it does not create an HTTP request.
reviews.side_effects_assessment: Refreshes local URL cache buffers at 2097175C/20971C74 from existing configuration; no network transmission or persistent change.

reviews.name: wifi_conman.get_p2p_pin
reviews.proof: A047C982 copies the existing eight-byte PIN from 20E2ACA8. Handler terminates the ninth byte and prints P2P_PIN=%-8s. No PIN generation, WPS start, radio operation, or configuration setter.
reviews.side_effects_assessment: Only reads local firmware/RAM data and formats UART output; no persistent update or external transmission.
reviews.data_sensitivity: May contain the user-owned device pairing PIN; retain as local reference evidence.

reviews.name: wps.status
reviews.proof: A04C3564 with selector 99 selects the current local adapter via A04C4B62/A02D658A, then A04C31F4 reads cached progress/error through mutex-protected helpers A04C48EE and A04C4930. Does not call WPS start or scan.
reviews.side_effects_assessment: Only reads local firmware/RAM data and formats UART output; no persistent update or external transmission.

reviews.name: rest_fw_update.get_state
reviews.proof: Required argument is class ID. ROM enum table 20853798 identifies 2 as WebFWUpdate, and A037FC6A accepts this class. A03802BC reads service cached state/error and DSID 0x125CD. State conversion A037FE46 reads DSID 0x125CC and A037FDF4 may retain source states 1 or 4 in its RAM latch. No download/apply request.
reviews.side_effects_assessment: Reads current service data and may refresh the RAM state latch at 20D9278C to 1 or 4. No persistent write, update activation, or network request.

reviews.name: l10n.get_language
reviews.proof: Static interface A05BCFF8 method +0xB4 targets A02CAD31 -> A02CB5EA. It reads DSID 0x1124E and checks language availability, falling back to 1 if unavailable. Returns through UDW integer formatter.
reviews.side_effects_assessment: Only reads local firmware/RAM data and formats UART output; no persistent update or external transmission.

reviews.name: cntrs.get_dsid

A0037ACA searches counter metadata tables rooted at 208969CC and returns a mapped DSID; A0037B3A checks mapping existence (special excluded ID 5021 is not selected); A0037B7E/A0037C1A call the DS scalar reader through 208969D4 without increment, clear, or setter.
